articles.title: Global Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) Framework and Multi-lateral Governance
articles.summary: India leads international consensus on adopting interoperable and open-source Digital Public Infrastructure frameworks to accelerate inclusive economic growth in the Global South.
prelims: India's DPI architecture rests on three core pillars: Digital Identity (Aadhaar), Fast Payment Systems (UPI), and Consent-based Data Sharing (Account Aggregator).
The Global DPI Repository (GDIR) is a virtual initiative developed under India's G20 Presidency to share institutional practices globally.
DPI differs from proprietary platforms by utilizing open standards, open APIs, and public oversight to prevent monopoly lock-in.
articles.mains: Examine how India's Digital Public Infrastructure model serves as an instrument of soft power and digital diplomacy in advancing Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

articles.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission: SIGHT Component Expansion & Grid Integration Guidelines
articles.summary: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy releases revised operational guidelines for electrolyser manufacturing and green ammonia production under the Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) scheme.
prelims: The National Green Hydrogen Mission targets at least 5 MMT (Million Metric Tonnes) annual production capacity by 2030.
SIGHT scheme provides direct financial incentives for domestic electrolyser manufacturing and green hydrogen production.
Green Hydrogen is produced via water electrolysis using electricity generated entirely from renewable sources, yielding zero direct carbon emissions.
articles.mains: Discuss the techno-economic hurdles in scaling green hydrogen adoption in energy-intensive sector like steel and fertilizers, and suggest policy remedies.

articles.title: Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) Enforces Tier-IV Stubble Management Directives
articles.summary: CAQM issues mandatory ex-situ and in-situ crop residue management targets for NCR states to curtail seasonal air pollution spikes ahead of winter.
prelims: CAQM is a statutory body established under the Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas Act, 2021.
In-situ stubble management utilizes equipment like Happy Seeder, Smart Seeder, and Pusa Decomposer, while ex-situ focuses on bio-pelletization and thermal power plant co-firing.
Primary atmospheric pollutants released during paddy stubble burning include particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10), Carbon Monoxide (CO), Methane (CH4), and Oxides of Nitrogen (NOx).
articles.mains: Critically analyze the structural challenges in agricultural residue management in Northern India and evaluate the statutory mandate of CAQM in enforcing compliance.

articles.title: Constitutional Amendment Framework for Simultaneous Elections in India
articles.summary: High-Level Committee recommendations on 'One Nation, One Election' undergo parliamentary scrutiny regarding necessary constitutional and legal amendments.
prelims: Implementing simultaneous elections requires amending Article 83 (Duration of Houses of Parliament) and Article 172 (Duration of State Legislatures).
Constitutional amendments affecting federal structures require ratification by at least half of the State Legislatures under Article 368.
First general elections to the Lok Sabha and all State Legislative Assemblies were held simultaneously in 1951-52, continuing until 1967.
articles.mains: Evaluate the concept of simultaneous elections in light of India's federal structure, democratic accountability, and administrative expenditure.

articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: Deep-Sea Trials for MATSYA 6000 Human Submersible
articles.summary: National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) advances deep-water validation tests for MATSYA 6000 under India's flagship Deep Ocean Mission.
prelims: MATSYA 6000 is a crewed deep-ocean submersible designed to carry 3 personnel to an ocean depth of 6,000 meters.
The Deep Ocean Mission is an umbrella initiative led by the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) to explore deep-sea resources and ocean biodiversity.
Central Indian Ocean Basin (CIOB) holds vast reserves of Polymetallic Nodules containing strategic metals like Nickel, Cobalt, Copper, and Manganese.
articles.mains: Highlight the strategic and economic significance of the Deep Ocean Mission for India's Blue Economy and critical mineral security.
